svg.title: The thread of an answer
svg.desc: Dennis writes a text in a thread of the chat. The answer to /help or an error goes into that thread at once. Free text goes to the control repository, and the pager keeps its thread while it waits. The answer of the control repository, a note, a failure or a proposal with its Confirm button, goes into the same thread. General, a text from before threads, an answer more than a day late and a thread that Telegram doesn't find get theirs in the main view.
